items.description: Fix GH #51: make pyo3-polars optional behind the `python` feature, cfg-gate all #[polars_expr] pl_* shims and shim-only helpers (output dtype fns, kwargs), add `cargo clippy --no-default-features --lib -- -D warnings` to CI, fix README/docs/lib.rs Rust dependency instructions (crate is not on crates.io; use git dependency on tag)

Fix GH #52: add central as_f64/as_u32 input upcast helpers in src/expressions/inputs.rs (numeric/bool -> Float64; integers -> UInt32 via strict_cast), replace all input `.f64()?`/`.u32()?` accesses in src/expressions, add Rust test and dtype-parametrized Python tests (Int32/UInt32/Int64/Float32 match Float64 results)
